notes.title: Change in the Keyboard Controls mapping!
notes.content:
Hello Guys,

I've listened to you and I've changed the mapping of keyboard controls to please the majority of the players - that are used to playing with the WASD system.

From now on:

[list]
[*] Keyboard Mode 1 = WASD + Space (Default)
[*] Keyboard Mode 2 = Arrows + Enter (KeyPad Enter as well)
[/list]

Thanks for your support!
GDS
